solution_components.name: Gemini platform
solution_components.role: Coordinates multi-agent workflows, tool calling, and governed automation across the application.

solution_components.name: Cloud Run
solution_components.role: Runs serverless or virtualized application services with elastic scale for production AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Pub/Sub
solution_components.role: Moves high-volume events and API traffic between services so the workflow stays decoupled and resilient.

solution_components.name: Firestore
solution_components.role: Stores transactional state and application data for the operational workflow at low latency.

solution_components.name: BigQuery
solution_components.role: Stores and queries the analytics and AI-ready datasets that power the workload.

solution_components.name: Model Armor
solution_components.role: Adds governance, security, and control to the production AI and data environment.

solution_components.name: Gemini models
solution_components.role: Provides the reasoning or generation layer used for classification, orchestration, content generation, or analysis.
